name: Pasifik Holding
verdict: Owned by its private Erdoğan-family shareholders. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Privately held Turkish investment group (55 companies, chairman Fatih Erdoğan); no state or fund ownership found on the company's own site or in press coverage. Front-of-shirt sponsor of Galatasaray since 2025-26 ($10m+VAT per season, revised to a reported €10m for 2026-27).
